agentDetail.inviteFailed: Invite failed — please confirm the user id is correct
agentDetail.deleteConfirmDesc: It will disappear from the list, but its versions and review history are kept.
agentDetail.versionsEmpty: No versions yet — use "New Version" above to create the first draft
agentDetail.inviteExtra: The invitee will get editor access. Ask an admin to look up a user id on the Users page.
agentDetail.addVersionDesc:
This creates a draft version. Afterwards you can freely edit its URL, streaming, dependencies, and other parameters on the version detail page —
nothing goes to review until you submit it yourself.
agentDetail.endpointUrlExtra: You can continue editing other parameters on the version detail page

versionDetail.submitFailed: Submit failed — please confirm the selected reviewer is valid
versionDetail.downloadLinkFailed: Couldn't get the download link — this version may not have passed review yet
versionDetail.draftAlertDesc: The parameters and dependencies below are saved individually when you press "Save"/"Add". While in draft, you can revise them repeatedly without affecting anyone. Once you press "Submit" in the top right and pick a reviewer, it formally enters review and the version is locked from further edits.
versionDetail.inReviewAlertDesc: This version has been submitted. Parameters and dependencies can't be changed until the reviewer on the right makes a decision.
versionDetail.rejectedAlertDesc: Check the reviewer's notes in the review history on the right, fix the parameters or dependencies below, then press "Resubmit" in the top right — no need to create a new version. This version's review history keeps accumulating, and past rejection notes stay too.
versionDetail.reviewerExtra: Only users with the reviewer or admin system role can be assigned. Leave blank to notify all reviewers/admins automatically.
versionDetail.reviewerPlaceholder: Leave blank to notify all reviewers automatically

reviewDetail.actionFailed: Action failed — this review may already have been processed
reviewDetail.commentRequired: A comment is required when rejecting, so the submitter knows what to fix
reviewDetail.title: Review: {{slug}}
reviewDetail.commentExtra: Required when rejecting; optional when approving.
reviewDetail.notAssigned: This review isn't assigned to you, so you can't act on it.

reviewQueue.description: Agent version submissions awaiting review. Admins see every reviewer's items; a regular reviewer only sees the ones assigned to them.
reviewQueue.forbidden: Only reviewers or admins can see the Review Queue.
